notes.origin: composite builder 8ff8c7a blocker 'FOLIO API GAP' (lib.rs Source arm allowed raster/vector/text only); lead decision option A

design.source_arm: lib.rs validate(): kind adjustment accepted in the Source arm when the payload is PrimitiveReference{schema_id: hsk.studio.adjustment@1, object_id == own layer id}; output port out, image, one, source (same descriptor as raster). PrimitiveReference of another schema or another object id -> PayloadMismatch; Unsupported payload -> UnsupportedDescriptor (unchanged); wrong ports -> InvalidPort (existing)
design.record_existence: validate_raster_records already refuses an adjustment layer without its record (DanglingReference) and a record on a non-adjustment layer (PayloadMismatch); the document validator reports an unresolvable adjustment primitive as a ResolutionIssue (Snapshot::require_available -> Unavailable)
design.clip_base: raster.rs validate_adjustment_clip_bases (called from validate()): per group, inputs walked by input_ordinal bottom first; base = nearest earlier unclipped input; a clipped layer whose base is an adjustment layer -> new Code::AdjustmentClipBase (target = clipped layer). Spec reading: STU-RAS-015 base = a layer's content/alpha; STU-RAS-007 adjustment is applied to layers below or clipped to its parent (= the adjustment is the clipped layer); no clause names an adjustment layer as a base -> refused, matching pigment PlanError::AdjustmentClipBase. Photoshop behaviour UNVERIFIED
design.additivity: no field added to any struct; one new Code variant (dependents match Code with wildcards, verified by the dependents check); documents without an adjustment layer in the graph validate as before (test existing_documents_validate_identically)

consumer_follow_ups: interop-psd: emit a Source op and an input_ordinal for adjustment layers; a PSD layer clipped to an adjustment layer would now fail validation with AdjustmentClipBase (importer must unclip with a loss receipt or refuse typed)
composite: lower() already maps a Source op with an image output to Step::Source; the adjustment_not_in_composition_graph refusal can be narrowed to layers truly absent from the graph
